notes: Food deliveries use administered warehouse markets with actual grain, paid handling labor and a supplied, historically eligible land army on the same local route. A 100-unit shipment normally loses 25 units; 800 bp avoids floor(25*800/10000)=2 units of waste. No output when disconnected.

The Yangzhou-Zhenjiang authored river link connects two historical canal nodes at the Grand Canal/Yangtze crossing. Freight requires the paid Yangzhou canal quay and both administered endpoints. This is local canal transshipment, not a new ocean passage. Existing construction bills and daily labor remain real.

Freight moves existing allowed commodity stock between endpoint markets, capped per campaign day across both directions and all commodities. Fee is ceil(quantity*100/10000), minimum 1 treasury currency unit; the endpoint workforce must exist. Research raises 100 units/day to 110, with no accumulated missed-day allowance. Capture retains infrastructure and used capacity, while benefits follow the current controller's research.

Food uses the materialized market service location or its nearest traversable land approach within 512 map units. A warehouse without a verified nearby land approach is not an operational army-food depot.
